lines.text: So when's the last time you went to Ixia?
Never.
You gotta be kidding me!
New York born and raised baby!
I haven't seen you in a minute, brotha.
Yeah, case I've been working's been... consuming...
Are you okay?
After today... I will be.
It's nice to fight alongside a fellow Ixian.
Ixian. Human. Chupacabra. Makes no difference to me.
Have you been here so long that you forgot where you came from?
I know where I'm from...and that's why I don't give a shit!
You worked at the scrapyard, right? The one the old lady runs?
That's right.
How, uh... How's she doin'?
I didn't realize you two were acquainted.
No we're not. I just, um... I just wanted to make sure she was doin' okay.
She's been better...
Sorry to hear that.
Are you thinkin' we can win this thing, tin man?
I know we will.
You scared of fire?
It's... not my favorite.
So yes.
Let's just say I'm... glad you're on my side.
I'd buy you a drink when this is all over but...
No mouth. I get it.
You don't seem particularly nervous.
Not my first time lighting things on fire.
That's good. I think.
Those guardians won't be standing for long.
No ma'am, they won't be.
What you're doing is noble.
Excuse me?
Helping your friend. It's noble.
Well... he'd do the same for me.
Hm, I'm not sure if the statute of limitations lets me answer that question, honestly.
You're not in my jurisdiction.
How about when this is over, we have a chat at the bar?
Sounds like a plan.
Sounds like a date.
You in town for long?
God, I hope not.
Afraid of the big city?
Not afraid. Just don't like it.
I'm sorry about what's going on in Ixia.
Don't know much about it.
You don't care about what's happening back home?
I was born in New York. "Home" is right here.
That came across poorly, didn't it?..
Yessir it did.
I'm assuming there will be a celebration at Jezebel's after we win?
You know it.
How is Hank?
He's nervous. The bar's not pulling in what it used to, and he's got a bunch of issues with the Alchemy Bureau.
Anything I can do to help?
You're doing it right now.
What's Johann up to?
At this moment, his two favorite hobbies are medicine, and being sanctimonious.
He's a good kid.
I'll keep him for now.
You wanna swing by the bar afterwards to celebrate?
Nah, Jezebel's not my scene. Too fancy.
Hank'll pick up the tab.
I'm in!
We're gonna make short work of those Guardians.
You know it.
How you guys doin'?
Not bad! Work is interesting and violent, Momo's trying his paws at pottery, I am 31 chapters into my memoir.
Memoir?
My friend, if I died before telling the world of our adventures, it would be a far greater crime than any we have committed.
I'm surprised you stayed in New York with the OSIC settin' up shop.
What do I have to fear from an inept government?
Inept? They caught you before.
Oh sure they did.
Hank's lucky to have a friend like you.
Well, I'm lucky to have a friend like Hank.
Whaddya say we summon a god and save a bar?
Let's do it.
You sure you wanna do this?
Hank needs me. I can't let 'em down.
Are you nervous?
Only that I'll like it.
I'd hate to see what kind of homilies you're dropping on Sundays.
I don't serve at a parish.
Can't imagine why.
You look nervous.
I'm next to a crazy preacher with a gun. Why wouldn't I be?
Do you always oversimply things?
What nuance am I missin' here?!
I have two guns.
Real funny, Father.
You're haunted.
Ain't you heard? The whole city's haunted.
You know what I mean.
...I really thought I buried this part of me, y'know.
A lot of people try to bury the past. Problem with that is whenever someone comes to go dig it up, they make a big mess.
Got any advice?
Yeah. Win. Otherwise you're torturing yourself for second place, and that's not worth it.
What're you fighting for, anyway?
Savin' my friend's bar.
You're putting your life in danger over real estate?
Hank saved my life. Least I can do is save his business.
You figure out where any of you came from yet?
No.
I'm sorry, man.

For a while I thought my left foot belonged to an accordion player in Milwaukee that was ritually murdered. Turns out he had lost the foot to gangrene, so that was 4 hours on a Greyhound I'm never getting back.
Oh.
And this other time there was this dad and-
Uh, hey, the uh... ritual's startin'.
You're not in the mood for friendly chit-chat are you?
No sir, I am not.
Then let's get to work.
Y'know there was a time when I was angry too.
Don't try to relate to me. You're still alive.
Fair enough.
Heard you're the one taking out the Friends of Humanity.
Let's say that's true. How do you feel about it?
I ain't losing sleep.
Do you always dress fancy, or is it just for work?
Look good, feel good, baby.
I need a tie!
You goddamn right you do!
How you liking New York?
People-watching is fun!
You should stop by Jezebel's sometime. If you like people watching, you'll see all types there.
What's that?
The bar my buddy Hank owns.
Why isn't it called "Hank's"?
Long story. I'll tell you later.
It's gonna be offensive how fast we burn down their objectives.
You know it.
How's working at the boring bar?
Legal doesn't mean boring.
Kinda does.
Hank's a good man.
He is. A good. Boring. Man.
It's ok, you can say it.
Say what?
That you miss me.
I don't.
Practice that line more so that next time you say it, I might believe you.
That tome is pulling you into deep waters, detective. Be careful.
Ehh... Don't know if I need life advice from somebody who was caught and executed.
Yet, here I stand. Perhaps you should consider that I know what I'm talking about.
I shouldn't be seen with someone like you.
Already playing politics, I see?
I have a responsibility to my family.
No... you have a yoke that you chose to don.
You're the one who escaped Lost Whisper.
I am.
What was it like?
I don't have time to wax poetic about the indignities I suffered.
Just enough time to wax poetic about brushing me off?
Silence, child!
Once I've rendered them helpless, run them through.
There's no honor in stabbing someone who can't defend themselves!
No... but there is glory in victory. And victory is all that matters today!
You're not like the other organics.
My dear scrap golem. I'm not like any man you've ever met in your life.
I don't understand you, Professor. You've been bestowed a great gift, and you're willing to throw it all away for nothing.
Easy words to say when you've never loved someone.
No. Easy words to say when you have.
I'm a fan of your work, Professor.
I am... flattered and horrified in equal measure.
Your research into the Astral Gates paved the way for my own. In my rare moments of doubt, sometimes I even wonder if I would have become the man I am were it not for you.
... And now I'm just horrified.
I'm sure it's a touchy subject, but I simply must know how you stopped your soul from being obliterated!
I mean no disrespect, Professor, but some things may be beyond you.
Many things are, but if I let that stop me from trying to learn, I wouldn't be... Well, I probably would still have my body.
Hmm... Perhaps we're cut from the same cloth.
Let's not go that far.
I'll consider your request, Professor.
Be careful, child.
What, or I'll end up like you?
Ha, please! Stay on the path you're on and you won't live long enough to end up like me.
Don't pretend like you care if I live or die.
I'm not invested in your survival, I just hate to see talent wasted.
Don't trust your mentor.
Why, cause she's a lich?
No, because mentors only teach what they want you to learn. They are craven and use the young to live glories they could not achieve on their own.
She's not like that.
Ohoho, of couse not. She sees potential in you that she's never seen in ages. You're special.
You don't know what you're talking about.
You're right. How silly of me.
I'm able to hold my own.
I never said you couldn't.
I know I'm young, but-
I don't care how old you are. If you're competent you'll survive, if you're not you'll die. Either way, you're not my concern.
If I was still in the Baxter Society, they would probably ask me to hunt you down.
Fortunately for you, that's not the case.
Someone's confident.
Someone's a visionary.
Good luck on your quest for revenge. The small-minded deserve to be culled.
Thank you.
Eh-Hmm... This must eat at you. Fighting beside me?
Don't flatter yourself.
Oh, we're going to have so much fun together.
Do your superiors know you're helping me?
We're not having this conversation.
Aw, struck a nerve?
After we summon the patron, how long do you wanna wait before we turn on each other?
I assume forty-eight hours is a pipe dream?
Obviously.
Sixteen?
Acceptable.
See you soon.
When this is over, I have to turn you in.
When this is over, if you're determined to throw your life away, I would be happy to take it.
How do you know Allie?
You haven't heard? She's writing a story about me.
Why?
I'm fascinating.
I can't believe the OSIC wanted to recruit that thing.
You're too smart to be that naive.
I'm not sure how I feel about working with you...
Grateful. You should feel grateful.
Why do you hate me?
The Patron will reveal all.
And then what?
Then I let you stew on when I'll come to kill you.
I see you're finally addressing your Oathkeeper problem.
What do you know about Oathkeeper?
I know that Faustian bargains rarely have happy endings.
I can't believe I'm about to be seen with a criminal.
I think public image is the least of your worries.
It's the only thing to worry about. If I die, I won't have to deal with the shame of associating with you.
Your pursuit of vanity is as pathetic as it is cliché.
Who do you think you are to speak to me like that?
Your better.
Ugh.
They say you have quite the ego.
Mediocre people say lots of unintelligent things.
On this, we can agree.
All your brilliance is wasted toiling for Fairfax.
Not wasted. I'm getting paid a fortune!
So you're content with being a wage slave.
Pretty much.
How depressing.
You ever take that thing off?
It's impossible.
For someone who likes to talk about having no limits, you sure seem quick to give up the ghost on that one.
Hmm.
When this is over, come find me.
So you are Nashala's pawn?
I serve at her pleasure, yes.
It's so nice to work with someone who understands their place.
So... Wyoming?
I know.
Good luck with that.
How do you like working for the Djinn?
Well enough. Sometimes it's frustrating, when Nashala makes impulsive, short-sighted decisions.
Such as?
Asking me to trust you.
[Laughter] You're fun!
I hear you have made the old subway tunnels your home.
Temporarily, yes.
We never gave you permission.
That's because I didn't ask.
Uh, do you want to come up with a plan?
The mole grabs them, then I make them suffer.
For all the might your organization wields, you waste it on publicity stunts.
We don't need to explain ourselves to you.
I would settle for you explaining it to anyone.
Did your masters at The Vatican send you? [Gasps] Or are you thinking for yourself for a change?
The fact that there's not a stake through your heart should be answer enough.
Orders it is.
Smart lad.
You killed a friend of mine.
[Laughter] oh, please! You're still willing to work with me? I killed a work acquaintance at best.
Aren't you planning on offering me a benediction?
No.
Thought you were in the business of saving souls?
You'd have to have one first.
Look at us. Both victims of the state.
Don't draw parallels between us.
I'm grateful to fight besides someone who has shed the albatross of morality.
Some people deserve to die.
And die they shall.
So what do you do?
Strive for apotheosis.
That's a big word.
Indeed.
What does it mean?
Once we summon the Patron you will see for yourself.
You need me to buy you a pair of shoes?
No.
You wanna walk in Times Square barefoot, be my guest!
I'm trusting you to help keep me alive.
Don't worry detective, I'll do my part.
How long you've been in New York?
Since the first Maelstrom.
That had to be an adjustment.
It was wonderful and horrifying in equal measure.
You're the one I read about in the papers, right?
Depends what you read.
That known associates of John Hawthorne and the Friends of Humanity have been winding up dead.
That could be me or Wesley.
They were shot in the 'ead. With a high-powered rifle.
Yeah, that was me.
What's on your mind?
Murder.
That sounds rather, uh... Intense! I think I'll let you be.
Why limit yourself to the Friends of Humanity when there's plenty of people that deserve to die?
You have to start somewhere.
Now that's some ambition I can appreciate!
What's with the rifle? Don't like working up close?
I'm not psychotic enough to have a preference.
I thought I was gonna like you.
Just to get this out of the way, I'm not precious about murder. If I'm carving someone up and you wanna take the shot, I'm not gonna be offended.
How magnanimous of you.
We're a team, right?
Hold them in place, Professor, and leave the rest to me.
That sounds rather ominous, and I'm ok not asking questions.
You know, I have a friend in the history department that would be over the moon if he got to meet you.
I'm not a prop for show and tell.
You are not, and I'm sorry to offend you.
You're a professor at Columbia, yes?
Indeed I am.
Isn't that where John Hathorne will be speaking soon?
Regrettably.
If the ritual fails, we'll be speaking later.
... Okay.
This is our moment, Wesley.
It is. And we won't squander it.
If all goes well today, this might be the last time we see each other.
I know.
That makes me sad.
Me too.
Wesley, I just... I just wanted you to know that if I had a father like you, I don't think I would have died.
You deserved better. I'm sorry.
It's okay... I got to meet you.
Are you interested in joining the OSIC?
I think I've had my fill of state-sanctioned murder.
So that's a no.
Emphatically.
How can you work for them?
I love my country.
I don't know why I'm bothering to reason with a zealot.
I'm not a zealot. The OSIC isn't perfect and neither is the world. You of all people should understand that the ends justify the means.
How good are you at hitting moving targets?
I shot Hathorne's brother while he was day-drinking on a speedboat.
... I'm gonna pretend that was a joke.
It was not.
You know I have to arrest you now.
When this is over, you are more than welcome to try.
You're rather cheerful today.
Carlos always says it takes more muscles to frown than to smile.
Carlos sounds like a preschool teacher.
First grade!
Close enough.
So, you're a wight.
Ehh, some people say Revenant, but... I'm not sure if there's really a difference.
I understand. I just stick with "ghost" for simplicity's sake.
Are you ready to summon a god?
I'm ready for revenge.
Then don't waste your opportunity.
It's unbelievable. I was killed because people thought I was someone like you. Meanwhile, you're an actual monster, and you get to run around like the belle of the ball.
That's because I am the belle of the ball.
You're going to actually support me and not just fly away, right?
If you want help, all you have to do is ask.
This isn't the time to be smug. Both of our futures are at stake.
I'm surprised you're getting your hands dirty. I thought someone like you would send out goons to do the messy work.
I believe in leading by example.
So do I.
How do you like being a ghost?
I'd rather not be dead.
Checks out.
And now I have to work alongside a brute.
I am right here.
Correct. That's why I'm exasperated.
Nice arm.
It's a malevolent spirit. Nice book.
It's a cursed tome.
You look... remarkably calm for a lady who's about to be shot at.
If I thought we were dealing with anyone competent, maybe I'd be worried.
So you're calm because you're delusional?
Confident, detective. I am confident.
Remember: When we summon the Patron, we need to be very specific about what we ask for.
Yes, yes, I know.
No going into business for yourself.
You worry too much, detective.
Great. I'm stuck working with an automaton.
Ah ben super, maintenant je suis coincé avec un bourgeois. (Ha, great. I'm stuck with an upper-class.)
Apologies. I didn't realize I was working with a man of culture.
You're not one of those machines that value human life, are you?
Not particularly. Beyond a few... notable exceptions.
Wonderful. We'll get along just fine.
When your ivory tower comes crashing down, I hope you're under it.
Be as snide as you like, at the end of the day I'll be sleeping in my penthouse, and you'll be chewing on a tin can, wondering where your life went wrong.
Oh, I know exactly where my life went wrong, lady.
Impressive. I'm sure you were spoiled for choice.
Been a while, friend.
I've never met you before in my life.
I was talking to your arm.
You know Oathkeeper?
Oh, we go back a long ways.
Oathkeeper asked me to give you a message.
Can't wait to hear it.
"See you soon."
[Laughs] oh, today is gonna be fun.
May I have a word, Professor?
Of course!
Your sport coat is wretched.
Not sure what to do with that...
Find dignity, and a halfway decent tailor.
I'll see what I can do.
That binding ward is looking in rough shape.
A fact that I am keenly aware of.
I would have that looked at soon.
Thank you for your concern, professor.
You seem preoccupied, professor.
Just thinking about my wife.
Is she alive?
Yes... and very patient. Hopefully after the ritual, that patience will be rewarded.
You're a man of science, Professor. Do you think what they say about the Patrons is true?

Well, it's clear that the Patrons are beings of immense power. Whether or not they actually intend to fulfill their end of the bargain is less about science and more about their nature. On the plus side: we're about to find out.
That ward on your arm. It's impressive.
Thank you.
I'm sure the Baxter Society would love to speak to whoever designed it.
Oh, he... Hm. He died.
Oh, pity.
Indeed.
You were a fool to make a deal with that thing.
Please, I'm in control.
If you were, I doubt you'd be risking your life right now.
You know... you're lucky. If the Baxter Society knew about your arrangement with Oathkeeper, they probably would have put you in the ground.
Don't be dramatic. The Baxter Society hunts rampaging monsters, not spirits under lock and key.
Oathkeeper's not the rampaging monster.
Nice gun.
It was a gift from my husband.
You know how to use it?
It looks like we're about to find out, aren't we?
I don't mean to be rude...
This should be good.
Your clothes.
What about 'em?
They're horrible.
Good talk.
Whatever happened to your friend that cause a scene at your fundraiser? His name was... Edward? Edgar, something like that?
Ettrick.
Yes. Ettrick.
I don't know. I tried to find him when I returned to New York, but it's like he's vanished.
Well, he was rather rude. So I say "good riddance".
I wish I could share that sentiment.
Well, take a look at green-armed Sally.
Don't talk to me.
That's fine by me, I'm just happy lookin'.
Whenever I decide to kill you, just remember it's because of this conversation.
It's a date.
Tell me you're competent.
Competent? No. I am god's gift to combat.
I can't tell if you're delusional or appropriately arrogant.
Yes.
I don't know how you do it.
You'd be surprised what you're capable of when the only other option is death.
Oh, I wasn't talking about murder. I was talking about pretending to be interested in people at fundraisers. I've seen you work the room at Fairfax's parties, it's... something else.
Oh. Johann dragged me to hundreds of those before. It's second nature.
Is that your husband?
Was.
Ugh. You smell of motor oil and labor.
That's because I work for a living!
How fun for you.
Yeah, turns out being a human being is good for the soul. You should try it sometime.
You're dressed practically.
Ah. Wit.
Seriously, how do you think you're gonna fight in that?
Your concerns are as unwanted as they are unneeded. Watch and learn.
You're Ambassador Nashala's bodyman, yes?
Correct.
When the ritual is complete, I'd love to have a chat with her.
What is it regarding?
That's not your concern.
But it is. When you decide that you wish to be forthright... let me know. And I'll consider your request.
Good help is hard to find. Nashala is lucky to have you.
It's an honor to serve her.
Oh, I like you.
That binding ward on your arm is... very impressive.
Thank you.
Whoever made it was an artist at their craft.
Yes. He really was.
I heard a rumor that you had one of my husband's paintings.
I wouldn't know, art's not really my thing.
I want it back.
I don't blame you.
I am not someone to play games with.
Lady, we already robbed you. You're exactly the person to play games with. If you want the painting back, I recommend that you try to find it. Good luck.
How often do your little social club gather?
A few times a year.
I'm assuming your ilk likes to brag about what they stole.
We're a bunch of bored rich people, of course we brag about what we stole.
You seem familiar.
I have one of those faces.
You were one of the urchins my foundation paraded around for good press, weren't you?
You got me.
You're welcome, by the way.
What's in your suitcase?
Nothing you want to see.
I believe you.
Who did you rob for that overcoat?
Excuse me?
That jacket is a Kelsey Evans. There's no way someone like you could afford it. Who did you rob?
Just leave me alone.
After the ritual, would you like to have a drink?
I don’t know. Word on the street is that you’re a dangerous woman to know.
I'm a dangerous woman, whether you know me or not.
What bar?
Jezebel's. Assuming the barman's not dead.
It's a date.
Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
I'm impressed.
I haven’t done anything yet.
You manage to make a pompadour look attractive.
Wait til you see me stab somethin’.
Darling, you're a delight.
Well, aren't you a ghoulish creature?
I'm a walking corpse.
I think we've established that.
My son's a doctor. You should speak to him.
What?
Your condition is only going to worsen without someone to maintain you, and Johann is one of the best in New York. I'll introduce you when this ritual business is concluded.
Why are you being nice to me?
I don't know... But speak of it to no one! I have a reputation to uphold.
Do you like goo?
No.
I do.
Wonderful.
I don't have a nose, but if I did, I bet your hair would smell like flowers.
It... kind of does, actually.
Neat!
I can't believe I have to work with the likes of you.
You don't even know me.
What's the point? You are either going to die during the ritual, or die in a gutter shortly thereafter.
You got a son?
Why?
'Cause I wanna marry into money. Like, wait five years and bump off my husband for the inheritance, 'cause this bird wasn't meant to be in a gilded cage, baby!
You know what the difference between us is?
You reek of new money.
I worked for what I have. It wasn't handed to me.
Spoken with a conviction only true ignorance can bring.
I like your hat.
Thanks.
Who is your haberdasher?
Jermaine.
That explains it. How long were you on his waitlist?
I had a marker on him, so not very long.
Hm. Nice.
I don't suppose you have any moral issue with taking people out while they're helpless?
Oh, I prefer it.
I think this will work out just fine.
だなんだその腕は? (What is that arm?)
Tu parles pas français, je parle pas japonais, mais on est quand même en train de se parler. (You don't speak French, I don't speak Japanese, but we're still talking to each other.)
Don't be a snob.
Take your own advice.
I can cut the arm off.
I'm good.
I really don't mind.
I'm sure you don't.
Now I'm not trying to cast aspersions detective, but in my experience, organics don't tend to last long in a fight.
Pal, the only thing you gotta worry about is keeping up.
So what's your deal?
I punch things. How about you?
Pretty much the same.
Oh, this is gonna be fun.
Stay close to me Professor, I'll keep you safe.
Detective, I was about to say the same thing to you.
I... don't suppose I could... take a look at that Tome, when all this is over?
Professor, if things go our way, there won't be a tome for you to look at!
You know they're gonna have guns, right?
Yep. They're also going to have arrows through their necks.
Fair enough.
You remind me of my stepdaughter.
Son married an Ixian?
Yeah.
No shit! Tell you what. We survive this, I'll take the whole family out for a drink.
That... that's a nice thought.
You should consider working for the OSIC.
I think you guys have enough people who can kick down doors.
We do. We don't have enough guys who care what doors are getting kicked down.
You're not gonna leave me out to dry, are you?
You may not see me, detective. But I promise you, I'm doing my part.
You got a plan?
Eh, I don't know... I was thinking you grab them and then I punch their skull in!
I like it!
So, you're the savior of Spanish Harlem, huh?
I really hate that nickname.
Heh. Not looking to be deified?
I just wanted to make my neighborhood safe.
The city owes you a debt for taking care of Mendoza.
I'm not owed anything.
Humility is good, but word of advice. Don't undervalue your worth.
So, a private detective is a job where you help people, but charge them money?
Help is relative. I'm pretty sure a lot of my clients wished I wasn't honest about what I found.
That's depressing.
Truth usually is.
If we work together, victory is assured.
You're... the most confident dead man I've ever met.
My friend, the grave has no time for pessimism.
You, uh... hot in that thing?
Revenants don't really sweat.
Huh. Checks out.
You're worried at the last minute that the Patrons are gonna screw us?
Detective, now more than ever we need hope, not skepticism.
Hope doesn't keep you alive.
Trust me, my friend. Sometimes, it's the only thing that does.
So, what does it feel like?
Excuse me?
Bein' next to greatness. What does it feel like?
Nauseating?
No need to be nervous. I am approachable.
Oh god...
Just wanna get this out of the way. I'm gonna be doing my best to support you but, shit happens and if you end up on the wrong side of a spectral wall... I'm sorry.
That was... very specific.
It happens a lot.
Ha, I picked up on that.
How do you not throw out your back carrying all that stuff?
It's lighter than it looks. Souls don't weigh a whole lot.
Just to give you a heads up, I plan on picking... a lot of fights today.
Good. I hate people.
Didn't expect to be working with you two today.
A delight for us as well! Our enemies will likely be... less enthused.
Oh, they are going to hate us.
What's in the case?
Something dangerous...?
You in trouble, kid?
Yeah, but you're not the person who can help me.
Look, about your old man...
Please don't talk to me like you know me.
You got it, kid.
It's ok to be scared.
I'm not.
You are, and it's okay.
How long have you been with the Baxter Society?
Not long, a few years.
Didn't think they let guys like you in.
Wasn’t easy. Who knows, in a few more years they might actually start to respect me.
And how long did it take you to do your hair?
Please, I wake up looking this pretty.
I’ll make ‘em bleed, you finish ‘em off.
Works for me.
Why are you wasting your time at a junk yard?
Helping Ms. Shelly is never a waste of time.
How long are you planning on lying to that lady?
I don't lie to her.
No. You just lie to yourself.
Heard you might be retiring.
